scope: THE OPERATIVE ACT bar s 3 (purposes), the regulation-making and appointment powers (ss 16Q, 21, 22, 27, 37, 38), the investigation powers in ss 16S, 24, 29(1)-(2) and 30 (encoded only as offences), and Third Schedule paras 1, 4, 6, 7, 12 to 15, 17 and 19 to 24 (duties of certification authorities and subscribers, encoded only where a rule turns on them). eta-records-contracts.l4 carries s 2(3) (place of business), s 4 and the First Schedule, s 5 (party autonomy), ss 7 to 10 (writing, signature, retention, originals), ss 11, 12 and 15 (contracts), s 13 (despatch and receipt), s 14 (invitations to make offers) and s 16 (input errors). eta-transferable-secure.l4 carries Part 2A (ss 16D, 16H, 16I, 16M, 16N, 16O), ss 17 to 19, and Third Schedule paras 3, 5, 11, 16, 18 and 23. eta-liability-enforcement.l4 carries s 25(4), s 26, the offences and their penalties (ss 16R, 23, 28, 29, 31, 33 and Third Schedule paras 8 and 9), s 32, s 36 and s 39. No regulations or exemption orders were retrieved.
